title: Isles++
description: QOL, performance, and visual upgrades for the Skyblock Isles Server
body:
### NOTICE: ISLES++ IS NOT AFFILIATED WITH THE SKYBLOCK ISLES SERVER IN ANY WAY



# Features:

- A collection of performance mods for high, stable framerates
- Distant Horizons to see the whole isle without a heavy performance hit
- Fancymenu and a custom texture pack for better GUIs (credit Looni for the main menu panorama)
- Several sound and ambience mods for a more immersive experience
- A heavily configured JourneyMap installation to create a map overlay for easier travel on the go
- And more!
